scientific_summary: Distinct delete-one pseudo-values of a complete square-integrable U-statistic have an exact negative-semidefinite cross-covariance equal to a weighted sum of Hoeffding covariance components of orders two and above. Exact uncorrelatedness is equivalent to an additive kernel; scalar correlations have a sharp finite-sample interval; and minus the cross-pseudo-value covariance is exactly the upward bias of the jackknife covariance estimator.
limitations: Complete one-sample U-statistics and delete-one jackknife only. The finite-sample result is compatible with asymptotic independence. Full theorem-level comparison with Arvesen (1969) and Shi (1984) was not possible, leaving residual originality uncertainty.
